purpose: Teach: 太る/引っかかる/ほた/スミマセン/ひねり/広々/昇っ/すれ違う

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Riku, you've been putting on weight lately.
lines.style: Dry, half-teasing observation. Quick delivery. A smirk in the voice — she's testing him, not attacking. Shoulder-shrug tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ノートの紐が引っかかる事になりそうぞ、桜
lines.en: Yeah? Your backpack strap's about to snap under the weight of your attitude, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick comeback, equally dry. Lean into the absurdity. Match her rhythm but with a slight edge — he's not hurt, he's playing. Light, unfazed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「ほた、テスト」とかつぶやくな
lines.en: Don't start muttering "ugh, test" under your breath again when things get hard.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost affectionate. A little exasperation mixed with knowing him. She's pointing out a habit she's noticed. Conversational, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ちゃんと「スミマセン」って言えよ、桜
lines.en: And you need to actually say "excuse me" properly when you bump into people, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady, straightforward guidance. No judgment in it — just matter-of-fact instruction. The tone of someone who's noticed she's been curt lately and is gently calling her on it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の解き方に、ひねりがあるな
lines.en: Though I have to say, your approach to that problem was actually clever.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation breaking through. Slower on the admiration. She doesn't hand out compliments lightly — this one lands. Slight emphasis on "actually."

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、新築は広々してんな、桜
lines.en: Your new place is seriously spacious, by the way.
lines.style: Warm observation, a little wistful. He's noticing the detail — not making a show of it. Gentle, genuine. The compliment of someone who isn't performative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、階段を駆けて昇って遅刻避けたな
lines.en: I saw you bolting up those stairs earlier trying to dodge being late again.
lines.style: Amused catch. He noticed something she thought she'd gotten away with. Light, not accusatory — there's affection in the observation. Slight laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、駅で先生とすれ違う時、ちゃんと挨拶しろよ、桜
lines.en: Make sure you greet the teachers properly when you pass them at the station, okay?
lines.style: Close, quiet, caring. Less directive than it reads — this is him looking out for her. Genuine concern underneath. Soft but firm enough that she'll remember it.
